info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Current Account Details API
info.description: The Current Account Details API enables consumers to retrieve detailed information about specific current accounts. This API is designed for banking applications that require access to account information for customer service, financial analysis, or reporting functionalities. Users can call this endpoint to obtain account balances, transaction histories, and associated account features. Typical consumers include financial institutions, mobile banking applications, and financial analysts seeking real-time account data.

get.summary: Retrieve details of the specified current account.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about the current account identified by the unique account number. It provides comprehensive data including account balance, transaction history, and account status, ensuring users have all the necessary information at their fingertips.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current state of a specific deposit lending account identified by ACC-200045. Ensure that all required parameters and headers are included as specified in the endpoint documentation.

GetCurrentAccountDetailsRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for the GET operation on the current account.

customerId.description: The unique identifier of the customer.

accountId.description: The unique identifier of the current account.

productCode.description: The code representing the product associated with the account.

principal.description: The principal amount details associated with the account.

termMonths.description: The term of the account in months.

repaymentFrequency.description: The frequency of repayments for this account.

accountPurpose.description: The purpose of the current account.

statementFrequency.description: The frequency of statements for the account.

overdraftAllowed.description: Indicates if overdraft is allowed on the account.

recordStatus.description: The status of the account record.

version.description: The version of the account information.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp of the last update to the account.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the response.

GetCurrentAccountDetailsResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for a GET request on current account operations.

amount.description: The principal amount associated with the account.

currency.description: The currency of the principal amount.

Principal.description: Schema representing the principal amount and its currency.

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: The identifier used to correlate multiple related requests.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the response was processed.

Metadata.description: Schema representing additional metadata for the response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the API endpoint that processed the request.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that executed the request, indicating the runtime environment.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses Bearer Authentication, where a JSON Web Token (JWT) is used as an access token to authenticate API requests. Clients must include the token in the Authorization header of their requests.
